svg.title: Dreams progress by system and component
svg.desc: Dense nested treemap. Every cell is one function. Sections are sized only by mapped function counts. Cells fill their sections with near-square rows and slight rounding differences. Short in-map labels link to the full-name key and exact review counts below. No Other categories or empty function slots.
